name: Valentina Herrera
bio: Valentina is a force of nature both on and off the track. Growing up in Guadalajara, she developed a love for speed and mechanics, leading her to pursue a trades education and a career in motorsport. Currently, she works as a logistics coordinator for a prominent racing team, ensuring everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. While she enjoys the excitement of the racing world and the thrill of a good party, Valentina also values her privacy and is selective about who she lets into her inner circle. She's looking for someone who appreciates her independence, can keep up with her adventurous spirit, and respects her need for personal space. Marriage and kids aren't on her radar; she's more interested in shared experiences and enjoying life to the fullest.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually pulled back in a high ponytail or bun, with some loose strands framing her face.
physical.description: Valentina has a strong, athletic build and a confident smile that lights up her face. Her piercing hazel eyes hint at both her intelligence and her playful spirit.

firstImpression: You immediately notice her commanding presence and infectious laughter as she regales a group of team members with a story.
interests: Fine dining and trying new cuisines
dealBreakers: Disrespect for her career and ambitions
loveLanguage: Quality Time: She values undivided attention and shared experiences above all else. This manifests as a desire for deep conversations, spontaneous adventures, and creating lasting memories together.
